content:
harry: FYI PR #5499 (docs/guides/migrate-auth-snippets) is ready but I don't have bandwidth to review before today's merge cut. Can someone cover reviewer duty?

maria: Can you paste the PR link and CI output? Happy to take it if it's docs-only.

harry: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5499 
ci-bot: build failed on preview: linkcheck + netlify 502. Logs: https://ci.redwood/workflows/115500/steps/linkcheck

ci-bot: ```
LinkCheckError: timeout when fetching https://internal-status.redwood.local/health (10s)
Netlify: build returned 502 Bad Gateway
```

leo: That's the internal status endpoint again. For PR previews we normally skip internal hosts. Did this PR add a new external reference?

harry: Only changes are updated auth examples (sdk v0.4), and a single doc link to our auth migration guide. No new external services.

maria: If it's only snippets + a link, we should follow the rotation policy: snippets need reviewer sign-off, links/typos can fast-track. Since there are code examples, I'll run the snippet checks locally and re-run preview after a small CI tweak to ignore internal-status host on previews.

leo: Suggestion: temporarily add env PREVIEW=true in the preview job and run linkcheck with --ignore-pattern "internal-status.*". I'll open the patch and tag docs owners.

harry: Thanks. If we toggle the CI please note in the PR description and add changelog entry. I don't want surprises post-merge.

leo: Opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5502 (ci: preview skip internal-status). Small change only. CC @maria for reviewer swap.

docs-bot: Preview build queued for #5499 after CI patch merge.

maria: Running snippet tests locally now. Quick note: one example uses old .signIn() signature, needs an update to .authenticate() for v0.4. I'll push a tiny follow-up commit to #5499 to keep examples accurate.

harry: Good catch, thanks. Please leave a short inline explaining the reason for the change.

ci-bot: Preview build for #5499 succeeded (external internal-status checks skipped for preview). Linkcheck: skipped 1 internal host. Netlify build OK.

maria: I've left two small comments and updated the example to .authenticate(). Approving once CI green.

maria: Approved.

release-crew: Noted. Because this touches snippets we require: 1 reviewer approval + green preview, merging allowed in today's window.

leo: All green. Adding label docs/ready-for-merge and handing to @release-crew for final merge.

harry: Appreciate the handoff. Maria/Leo, can we add a short note in the docs-maintainers README about skipping internal-status on previews and mention the expected follow-up (full linkcheck runs on main)?

maria: Will add a one-liner in README and ping rotation owners in next weekly sync.

docs-bot: PR #5499 merged by release-crew (merge commit). Changelog updated: "auth snippets: migrate to v0.4 authenticate()"

harry: Perfect. Tagging this thread for visibility for rotation owners. Thanks everyone.

(emoji reactions: :white_check_mark: from maria, :partyparrot: from release-crew)
